# Raul Zarza - Web Developer & SaaS Builder

> Web developer with 10+ years building SaaS, platforms, and digital tools for real businesses. Based in La Paz, Baja California Sur, Mexico.

## About

Raul Zarza is an independent web developer specializing in creating SaaS products and custom web platforms for businesses. With over a decade of experience, he focuses on turning manual processes into digital tools that save time and reduce errors.

## Projects

- [Mi Granja](https://migranja.app): SaaS for livestock management — inventory, reproduction, health records, and herd events
- [Baja Rent](https://bajarent.app): Platform for rental businesses — customer management, inventory, and payments
- [HUAM Deportiva](https://huamdeportiva.com): Platform to create, promote, and manage sports events in Baja California Sur
- [Baja Minigolf](https://bajaminigolf.com): Digital scoring system for a mini golf course in La Paz

## Services

- **Web platform development**: Full web applications, admin panels, APIs and databases
- **SaaS products**: Functional MVPs, multi-tenant systems, billing and subscriptions
- **Operations digitization**: Process automation, data migration, team training

## Tech Stack

React, Next.js, Firebase, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Astro, Supabase, tRPC, Cloudflare Workers
